title: Standard Table - incoming / periodic visual inspection
scope: Visual and manual inspection of an assembled table. Does not cover load testing, torque verification or dimensional measurement.

requirements.title: Tabletop surface and edges
requirements.instructions: Inspect the top surface and edge banding for chips, cracks, swelling, lifted edge band or sharp edges.
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the full tabletop from a high three-quarter angle, including at least one edge.
visual_limitations: Internal board damage is not visible in a photograph.

requirements.title: Front left leg
requirements.instructions: Confirm the leg is undamaged and tight in its corner.
acceptance_criteria: No movement at the corner joint

requirements.title: Front right leg
requirements.instructions: Confirm the leg is undamaged and tight in its corner.
acceptance_criteria: No movement at the corner joint

requirements.title: Rear left leg
requirements.instructions: Confirm the leg is undamaged and tight in its corner.
acceptance_criteria: No movement at the corner joint

requirements.title: Rear right leg
requirements.instructions: Confirm the leg is undamaged and tight in its corner.
acceptance_criteria: No movement at the corner joint

requirements.title: Front apron rail
requirements.instructions: Confirm the rail is present, uncracked and both end joints are closed.

requirements.title: Rear apron rail
requirements.instructions: Confirm the rail is present, uncracked and both end joints are closed.

requirements.title: Left end apron rail
requirements.instructions: Confirm the rail is present, uncracked and both end joints are closed.

requirements.title: Right end apron rail
requirements.instructions: Confirm the rail is present, uncracked and both end joints are closed.

requirements.title: Corner mounting brackets
requirements.instructions: From underneath, inspect each corner bracket and the visible fastening points.
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph one corner from below, showing the bracket, the leg and the hanger bolt with its nut.
visual_limitations: Fastener torque cannot be verified visually.

requirements.title: Hanger bolts present and tight
requirements.instructions: Confirm each hanger bolt nut is present and cannot be turned by hand.
requirements.photo_guidance: Close-up of one hanger bolt and nut.
visual_limitations: Torque and thread engagement cannot be verified from a photograph.

requirements.title: Floor glides and stability
requirements.instructions: Confirm a glide is fitted to each leg and the table does not rock.
